title: Atari Masterpieces Vol. I
statusNote: Logos, title and menus work. All eight arcade games start from Choose Game (Asteroids, Battlezone, Black Widow, Lunar Lander, Millipede, Missile Command, Red Baron, Super Breakout); Asteroids was played: the ship turns, thrusts and fires. The four Atari 2600 extras are locked until score targets are met, as on the console.
notes: Each game opens on its arcade attract screen; press 1 to start a one-player game.
Either soft key pauses a game. The pause menu has Control Keys (that game's keys, which can be changed there), Game Settings, and Quit Game to go back to the game list.
Adventure, Surround, Video Chess and Yars' Revenge (Atari 2600) unlock by reaching a score in Missile Command, Millipede, Red Baron and Asteroids.
N-Gage Arena is no longer online, so its menu entry does nothing useful here.

controls.source: Each game's Control Keys screen in its pause menu (defaults). Movement on the direction pad is not listed there; it was confirmed in Asteroids (turn and thrust) and is assumed for the other games.

actions.up: Menus: move up. Games: thrust (Asteroids), otherwise move or aim up
actions.down: Menus: move down. Games: move or aim down
actions.rsk: Back (menus); pause menu (in a game), resume (pause menu)
actions.2: Two-player start; Black Widow: fire up; Lunar Lander: rotation mode
actions.3: Black Widow: two-player start; Lunar Lander: add fuel
actions.4: Black Widow: fire left; Missile Command: fire Alpha base
actions.5: Fire; Missile Command: Delta base; Super Breakout: serve; Lunar Lander: abort
actions.6: Black Widow: fire right; Missile Command: fire Omega base

notes: Arcade layout: arrows move, Space is the fire key (5), 1 starts a game, Escape pauses. W/A/S/D are 2/4/8/6, which gives Black Widow its second stick (fire up, left, down, right) and Missile Command its Alpha and Omega bases on A and D; H is hyperspace in Asteroids. On a gamepad the right stick does the same and Start begins a game.

Keys per game, besides the direction pad and 1 to start: Asteroids 5 fire, 7 hyperspace. Battlezone 5 fire. Black Widow 2, 8, 4, 6 fire up, down, left, right. Lunar Lander 5 abort, 2 rotation mode, 3 add fuel. Millipede 5 fire. Missile Command 4, 5, 6 fire the Alpha, Delta and Omega bases. Red Baron 5 fire. Super Breakout 5 serve.
A two-player game starts with 2 in Asteroids, Millipede, Missile Command and Super Breakout, and with 3 in Black Widow.
